collection: IELTS Academic Listening Part 1 original practice
note: For supervised listening practice. Read the examiner script once with two speakers and hide the script, explanations and answers from learners.

listeningSet.title: Lamp repair workshop booking
listeningSet.learnerInstructions: Complete the booking form. Use one word or one number in each blank.
listeningSet.examinerInstructions: Show the form and allow time to read it. Read the dialogue once at a natural pace with two speakers. Award one mark per correct response; ignore letter case and accept the listed numerical variants.

examinerScript.speaker: Coordinator
examinerScript.line: Hello, Ridge Community Centre. How can I help?

examinerScript.speaker: Caller
examinerScript.line: I’m calling about Saturday’s lamp repair workshop. Is there space in the nine o’clock group?

examinerScript.speaker: Coordinator
examinerScript.line: That group is full, but the half-past-ten group still has room.

examinerScript.speaker: Caller
examinerScript.line: Half past ten is fine. Please book under Teni Balogun. That’s B-A-L-O-G-U-N.

examinerScript.speaker: Coordinator
examinerScript.line: How many places shall I reserve?

examinerScript.speaker: Caller
examinerScript.line: I thought there might be three of us, but my cousin still hasn’t confirmed. Just two places for now.

examinerScript.speaker: Coordinator
examinerScript.line: Certainly. The repair workshop costs three thousand five hundred naira per person. The four-thousand-naira price on our website is for a separate course.

examinerScript.speaker: Caller
examinerScript.line: Thanks. Where exactly is the entrance?

examinerScript.speaker: Coordinator
examinerScript.line: On Market Road, use the gate directly across the road from the library.

examinerScript.speaker: Caller
examinerScript.line: Do we need to bring any materials?

examinerScript.speaker: Coordinator
examinerScript.line: We’ll provide wire and batteries. Bring a torch so you can see inside the lamp housing. If you don’t have a screwdriver, you can borrow one from us.

examinerScript.speaker: Caller
examinerScript.line: Will there be anything to drink?

examinerScript.speaker: Coordinator
examinerScript.line: We provide drinking water free of charge. The kiosk sells tea if you prefer that.

examinerScript.speaker: Caller
examinerScript.line: Could you email the booking confirmation? Text messages haven’t been reaching me reliably.

examinerScript.speaker: Coordinator
examinerScript.line: Email it is. One last thing: please arrive by quarter past ten at the latest so we can register everyone before the workshop starts.

examinerScript.speaker: Caller
examinerScript.line: I’ll make sure we’re there in time. Thanks.

questions.subject: Listening
questions.learningObjective: Select the confirmed time after a proposed time is ruled out.
questions.explanation: The nine o’clock group is full. The caller accepts the half-past-ten group.

questions.subject: Listening
questions.explanation: The caller spells the surname B-A-L-O-G-U-N.

questions.subject: Listening
questions.learningObjective: Distinguish the number of places booked from an earlier estimate.
questions.explanation: The caller books two places because the cousin has yet to confirm.

questions.subject: Listening
questions.learningObjective: Select the fee for the requested activity.
questions.explanation: The repair workshop costs three thousand five hundred naira. Four thousand is the price of the separate course.

questions.subject: Listening
questions.learningObjective: Identify a landmark from a paraphrased direction.
questions.explanation: The speaker describes the gate as directly across the road from the library.

questions.subject: Listening
questions.learningObjective: Identify the item attendees must supply.
questions.explanation: The organiser provides batteries and wire but asks participants to bring a torch.

questions.subject: Listening
questions.learningObjective: Identify the tool available to borrow.
questions.explanation: The organiser explicitly offers to lend a screwdriver.

questions.subject: Listening
questions.learningObjective: Distinguish a provided refreshment from one sold separately.
questions.explanation: Drinking water is provided, while tea is sold at the kiosk.

questions.subject: Listening
questions.learningObjective: Identify the agreed way the booking confirmation will be sent.
questions.explanation: The caller chooses email because the text messages have been unreliable.

questions.subject: Listening
questions.learningObjective: Distinguish the registration deadline from the workshop start time.
questions.explanation: The organiser gives quarter past ten as the latest time to arrive for registration.
